quotes.text: If Mrs. Dyott was fond of ancient French furniture, and distinctly difficult about it, her inmates could be fond—with whatever critical cocks of charming dark-braided heads over slender sloping shoulders—of modern French authors.
quotes.reference: 1901, Henry James, The Story in It:

quotes.text: The guests run hands over twitching boys, suck their cocks, hang on their backs like vampires.
quotes.reference: 1962 [1959], William S. Burroughs, Naked Lunch, New York: Grove Press, page 80:

senses.definition: third-person singular simple present indicative of cock
